headline: Good hardening progress, but comment upsert can still be broken or weaponized in real PR traffic.

findings.point: Marker-only ownership check can cause fail-closed denial of service: find_council_comment picks any comment containing `<!-- council-review -->`, then upsert tries to PATCH it; if that comment is not authored by the workflow actor, GitHub returns 403 and the job fails (scripts/venice_review.py:115-128; setup/templates/venice_review.py:115-128).

Existing council comment lookup is single-page (`?per_page=100`) with no pagination/sort control, so on long PRs the marker can be missed and new comments get posted repeatedly, breaking the one-rolling-comment invariant (scripts/venice_review.py:113; setup/templates/venice_review.py:113).

_gh retry logic skips transient throttling paths (e.g., 429/408) because only 5xx is retried; under bursty repo activity this can still drop comment updates and fail the gate (scripts/venice_review.py:99-101; setup/templates/venice_review.py:99-101).

suggestions: When finding the existing council comment, require both marker match and expected author (`github-actions[bot]` or the current token identity) before PATCH.
Fetch comments in descending order and paginate until marker is found (or exhausted) to preserve S2 on high-comment PRs.
Extend tests with: (1) marker present on non-bot comment should not be selected, (2) pagination case with marker beyond first 100 comments, (3) 429 retry behavior with Retry-After handling.

headline: GitHub API errors (429, secondary rate limits, 4xx) and missing top-level exception handling still crash the gate or drop comments under load.

findings.point: scripts/venice_review.py:140 (_gh returns 429 immediately since <500, caller .raise_for_status fails the job)
scripts/venice_review.py:172 (find_council_comment + upsert_comment have no try around _gh; any non-retryable error aborts before run_pr_review)
scripts/venice_review.py:200 (no outer try around run_pr_review or client call; uncaught engine exception bypasses unavailable flag and fails closed)
scripts/venice_review.py:85 (upsert_comment does PATCH then POST without checking for 422/409 on concurrent comment edits)

suggestions: wrap main API sequence in try/except that still posts a failure comment
